description: This Python script demonstrates an explicit Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) loop for subtitle synchronization and correction using large language models (LLMs). It transcribes videos, aligns subtitles, retrieves relevant transcript segments, and interacts with LLM APIs (OpenAI or Gemini) for subtitle correction, then outputs the final corrected subtitle files. The script heavily relies on a backend src.processing package providing subtitle processing, RAG retrieval, and LLM integration functionalities.

methods.name: Tuple[str,List[SubtitleEntry]] _read_subtitle(fmt: str, path: str)
methods.description: Reads and parses a subtitle file into entries and optional header.

methods.name: None _write_subtitle(fmt: str, path: str, header: str, entries: List[SubtitleEntry])
methods.description: Serializes subtitle entries and header back into a file format.

methods.name: str _clean_single_line(s: str)
methods.description: Ensures subtitle text is a single normalized line.

methods.name: str _openai_complete(prompt: str)
methods.description: Performs a request to OpenAI API or returns a stub correction if not available.

methods.name: str _gemini_complete(prompt: str)
methods.description: Performs a request to Google Gemini API or returns a stub correction if not available.

methods.name: str _llm_fix_subtitle_line( model_choice: str, cue_text: str, start: float, end: float, topk_segments: List[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Builds prompt with context and retrieves corrected subtitle line from selected LLM.

methods.name: argparse.Namespace parse_args()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the script.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Main pipeline that orchestrates transcription, subtitle syncing, RAG retrieval, LLM correction, and final output.
